detections.title: The Unsuspecting Parallelogram
detections.subtitle: Callisto-South Unmanned Brine Evaporation Vat 19 (Frame 07)
detections.prop_title: Book I, Proposition 34 — Parallelogram Bisection & Congruence
detections.enunciation: In parallelogrammic areas the opposite sides and angles are equal to one another, and the diameter bisects the areas.

steps.clause: Given parallelogrammic area ABDC in the salt crust with opposite sides parallel: AB || CD and AC || BD to 0.0002 arcseconds.
Let the diameter BC be drawn across the brine sludge. Because AB || CD, alternate angles ∠ABC = ∠BCD (Euclid I.29); and because AC || BD, ∠ACB = ∠CBD.
Triangles ABC and DCB share common diameter BC and equal angles, therefore AB = CD, AC = BD, and diameter BC bisects parallelogram ABDC into two congruent triangles (G.47).
CALLISTO WATER BOARD PRESS RELEASE: 'A motorized mud-rake lost a cotter pin and dragged sideways across Vat 19.' That is one remarkably well-educated mud-rake, folks.

detections.narrative: At 03:12 GCT, the Van Allen ED-9 Hough correlator flagged Frame 07 from unmanned Brine Evaporation Vat 19 on Callisto-South. Etched into the crystalline salt crust was a razor-sharp parallelogram (AB || CD, AC || BD to 0.0002 arcseconds) with diameter BC cleanly bisecting the sludge into two congruent triangles (Euclid I.34 / G.47).
